question: What is the 'vicious cycle' in science education?
answer: Each time round the loop, a student feels surer of a wrong idea. The surer they feel, the less of the correct explanation gets in, so the next round starts even surer. Confidence in a wrong idea blocks the right one.
move: Confidence in a wrong idea blocks the right one, so tackle the misconception first.

web.label: A loop of two arrows labeled Confidence in Wrong Idea and Less Learning. A slider moves a student around the loop; each round, the student feels surer of the wrong idea and less of the correct explanation gets in.

source: Veritasium, “Khan Academy and the Effectiveness of Science Videos” (YouTube, 2011)
